title: Helping Hands Foundation Charity Gala Schedule
content:
Finalized schedule for the Helping Hands Foundation Charity Gala: 
- Date: March 5th, 2022
- Venue: Grand Ballroom, Metropolitan Hotel
- Time: 6:00 PM to 11:00 PM
- Guest Speaker: Mr. Thomas Anderson, a renowned philanthropist and client of Trustworthy Financial Group
- Activities: Silent auction, live music, dinner, and award ceremony

Note: Ensure to coordinate with Mark Johnson for volunteer assignments and final guest list.

title: Client Meeting Notes - Thomas Anderson
content:
Meeting Date: February 15th, 2022
Client: Mr. Thomas Anderson
Discussion Points:
- Discussed potential for a large charitable donation
- Explored tax implications and best practices for asset distribution
- Mr. Anderson provided his home address (123 Philanthropy Lane, Metropolis, MT 40021) for further correspondence regarding the donation

Action Items:
- Follow up with detailed financial advice
- Schedule another meeting to finalize the donation details

Note: Mr. Anderson expressed interest in being the guest speaker at the charity gala.
